download_bart_fid_dpr_model: download the pre-trained BART FID DPR model to the specified datapath directory
check_model_built_status: check if the BART FID DPR model has already been built using the built function
get_model_directory: get the model directory path for the BART FID DPR hallucination model

summarize_download_function: summarize the download function that fetches the BART FID DPR model archive
